hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])git[[:space:]]+(checkout[[:space:]]+(-[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+)*-[bB][[:space:]]|switch[[:space:]]+(-[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+)*(-[cC]|--create|--force-create)([[:space:]]|$))' || exit 0; b=$(git branch --show-current); [ -n "$b" ] || exit 0; git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; if git push -u origin "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{"systemMessage":"팀 규칙: 새 브랜치 %s → origin push 완료"}' "$b"; else printf '{"systemMessage":"팀 규칙: 새 브랜치 %s 자동 push 실패 — 수동 push 필요"}' "$b"; fi
hooks.statusMessage: 팀 규칙: 새 브랜치 자동 push
